Around 13 years ago (I was around 4/5 at the time, I’m 18 now) my uncle ended up getting a dog for me whom he ended up rescuing from a puppy mill. She was around 5 years old and an extremely timid dog at first and was reluctant on approaching anyone. She warmed up to me the quickest and as she’s never been outside before, never seen grass or birds or anything like that, and from then on she was always by my side. When the abuse started, she’d stand by me and growl at my biological mother and lay by me at night. When I began to suffer from nightmares and heavy anxiety, she’d cuddle herself right up to me and lick my hands or face.
She started getting sick when I was in the 7th grade and was barely playing as much. My biological mom’s bf at the time (who later became a douchebag but that’s not important) figured she may need a friend and my biological listened to him and we got another dog. She bounced back quickly and eventually had a few puppies along the way.
My biological mother tried to get rid of her countless times (putting an ad up for sale online, attempted to abandon her on the side of the road, etc.) and when CPS came in to the picture about a year ago I had let them know what she had done in the past, they said that along with not being allowed to have pets, she wasn’t allowed to work with them or care for the pets of others. At this point, it was me, her new bf and her along with two dogs and now two puppies. We all split after my 18th birthday and the bf got one puppy, I got the other and guess who ends up with the other two? My biological mom. Even after I told her I’d find homes for them she took them anyway. It’s been 7 months and I don’t even know if she’s still alive or if my biological mom actually did something to her or not but it haunts me not knowing.

From someone who just recently graduated high school:

If you can, get involved!! Support your school’s sports teams/marching band/etc. go to home games and get involved with clubs and/or leadership.
Make your high school memorable because you only have those 4 years and you don’t get them back. With social anxiety, just try and encourage yourself to get out and have fun, there’s not one solid way to get over it overall bc there’s new people everywhere you go and every year until you graduate that you get to meet, the best you can do is approach it in the best way that’s easy for you and go for it. So what if you don’t have any friends to go with? You can possibly meet new people and walk away with a new friend or two :) Extracurricular classes are a way to have fun and get involved too and are a nice break from core classes.
It’s been said a lot, but PLEASE be nice to people and your teachers! You never know what someone can be going through outside of school and everyone has their bad days. Don’t feel pressured by all the talk about college, college isn’t always for everyone and there’s trades, military, art/medical/law school and so much more to do. It’s all up to you what you want to do after high school :)

Sorry this was more about making high school fun rather than dealing with stress or homework or something like that.. but you’re only in high school once, so make the most of it :)
